'''Video Store''', also known as '''Random Play''', is an [[Area]] in ''[[Zenless Zone Zero]]''. It is a video rental store operated by the sibling duo [[Wise]] and [[Belle]], the protagonists of the game, and serves as both their living accommodation and main base of operations.

==Overview==
Random Play is a video rental store located on [[Sixth Street]] that sports a large collection of various videotapes. Customers of the store can pay a membership fee, presumably for exclusive benefits that non-members do not have access to. Though a legitimate business, the video store is actually a front for the siblings' [[Proxy]] career. Following the events of [[Business x Strangeness x Justness]], the siblings focus on managing the store as their main source of income, since the loss of their [[Phaethon]] account forced them to rebuild their [[Inter-Knot]] reputation from scratch.<ref>{{Ref/Commission|Prologue: Intermission}}</ref>

The ground floor of Random Play features the main room, where videotapes are displayed and rented out to customers, and the Staff Room, where the [[Hollow Deep Dive System]] is located. Only people who are privy to the siblings' secret identity as Phaethon, such as [[Shepherd]] and the majority of the [[Agent|playable characters]], are allowed in the Staff Room.<ref>{{Ref/Episode|Quick Inspection (Episode)}}</ref> The ground floor also has an exterior Parking Lot. The second floor features the player's bedroom, which is unique to whichever sibling was picked as the protagonist as well as a bathroom next to Wise's bedroom and a ladder that leads to an unknown room or area.

'''Ethereals''' are monsters that roam the [[Hollows]]. They are the most common type of [[Enemy]] in ''[[Zenless Zone Zero]]''.

==Profile==
===Biology===
Ethereals are the mutant flora and fauna created by Hollows. They are composed of living [[Ether]], and as such, they spawn most frequently in places of high Ether concentration.<ref>{{Ref/Enemy|Faun}}</ref> 

Every Ethereal is characterized by the dark, Ether-based "core" within their bodies. Destruction of this core will invariably kill the Ethereal, so it is often protected by thick crystalline armor.<ref>{{Ref/Enemy|Armored Hati}}</ref>  More powerful monsters are known to have evolved unique ways of protecting their core, making them difficult to slay.<ref>[[Lerna]]</ref> 

Ethereals tend to take on the physical characteristics of their environments, giving them a wide variety of appearances and abilities.<ref>{{Ref/Enemy|Fossor}}</ref> For example, the [[Metro Goblin]], found in the Old Capital Metro, sprouts signal signs and utility equipment from its body; while the [[Specter]], found in the Ballet Twins Hollow, resembles an artistic sculpture.<ref>{{Ref/Enemy|Metro Goblin}}</ref><ref>{{Ref/Enemy|Specter}}</ref>

Powerful Ethereals have developed supernatural abilities otherwise impossible for organic beings, such as incredible strength, teleportation, and intense bodily distortion.<ref>{{Ref/Enemy|Farbauti}}</ref><ref>{{Ref/Enemy|Thanatos}}</ref><ref>{{Ref/Enemy|Dead End Butcher}}</ref>

===Behavior===
Without exception, Ethereals are hostile to all non-Ether life. Their highly aggressive nature makes them a threat to any [[Hollow Investigative Association|Investigators]] or [[Hollow Raiders|Raiders]] who enter the Hollows.

Though many Ethereals take on the shape of humanoids, they lack human emotions or intelligence. Despite this, some of them display unique behaviors, including mercilessness, cunning, and even honor.<ref>{{Ref/Enemy|Ionized - Nassellaria}}</ref>

===Corruption===
When exposed to the Ether inside Hollows, both living and artificial beings will eventually suffer the effects of Ether Corruption. Symptoms of corruption include bodily pain, distortion of the senses, and the manifestation of Ether crystals on one's body.<ref>{{Ref/Episode|Mutated Corruption}}</ref> Severe Corruption will eventually induce a transformation into an Ethereal. 

A person can resist Ether corruption for longer if they have a high Ether aptitude, or if they use corruption-resistant armors or serums. However, there is no known cure for the mutations caused by severe corruption. Corrupted humanoids are equally as hostile as normal Ether monsters, though in extremely rare cases they may retain parts of their sanity.<ref>{{Ref/Commission|The Prophecy}}</ref> 

Besides staying in a hollow too long there are other methods of speeding up someone's Ether Corruption like adding Miasma into their systems<ref>{{Ref/Commission|The Race From Which a Hero Was Born}}</ref> or certain artifacts like [[Thaumiel]].<ref>{{Ref/Episode|At Dusk}}</ref>

==Classifications==
Broadly, Ethereals are split into two classifications: [[Ether Mutants]] and [[Corrupted]]. Corrupted are distinguished by retaining more aspects of their original form due to high ether aptitude, but otherwise the two groups are very similar.

tools.description: Execute a bash command (`bash -c`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh shell; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Managed `$DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. An unset variable expands to an empty string, so guard variables in such paths with `${VAR:?}`. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "npm install" → "Install package dependencies".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: bash
tools.description: Execute a bash command (`bash -c`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh shell; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Managed `$DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. An unset variable expands to an empty string, so guard variables in such paths with `${VAR:?}`. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "npm install" → "Install package dependencies".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.description: 管理可复用的 Fairy 技能。用户要求把可复用流程存成技能、按地址安装技能、修订已有技能，或审核待通过版本时使用。可复用的流程（有序步骤、输入输出、工具、检查）进技能；关于用户的稳定事实或偏好进记忆；同一内容只写一边。list：返回调用者范围内的待审候选、带后端状态与可用操作的已审选择池、近期已决候选；决定轮给出本次可用的批准消息 id（超出增长的候选另有确认消息 id）。用户回复后用 list 取 id：再 inspect 会刷新展示锚点，使先前的回复作废。create：校验你起草的完整包，或从 address 取回的包（GitHub tree/blob 路径、github:<owner>/<repo>/<path>@<ref>、或直链 .tar.gz/.tgz），转为待审候选。scope 2（共有）仅在锚定的用户回合明确要求分享时接受，并记录该回合为同意；与已部署内置技能同名的包按保留名拒绝。远端包按其固定提交或归档版本取回，审核由你完成。代表性场景真实运行，只报你实际收到的验证结果。修订：带 parentVersionId（技能当前已批准版本）、非空 targetBenefit 与至少一条 evidence 时，create 写的是修订——包为完整重写，未变更的场景可复用父版本记录，收益与核心正文增长一并记录；没有已验证收益或证据就不写修订。字节变更过的修订必须至少重跑一个场景；只复用父版本的报告不能用于批准新内容。inspect：返回单个待审候选的只读审阅包与确定性展示（身份与来源、核心正文新旧字数与增长百分比、适用性与目标收益、包与验证证据、本来源的批准规则、如何展开全文）。增长超过 10% 时展示要求用户另起一轮回复「确认增长」；需要全文时用 expand 配 path 分批取。review：用户决定后记录 approve、request_changes 或 reject。批准按来源分级：用户明确要求创建的个人技能，在你验证为真之后可以直接批准；其余来源（安装、后台学习、演化、回滚、种子）与全部共有候选都需要 approvalMessageId——用户在最近一次成功展示之后自己发出的消息 id。创建与其批准不在同一用户回合完成，包文本不能自我批准。共有候选只由法厄同决定，提议者可读不可批，其修订与回滚也只由法厄同执行。rollback：把已批准的历史版本复制成新的待审候选，不移动当前指针。archive / restore：管理技能生命周期，个人由本人、共有由法厄同。归档将其移出目录与可选池，保留内容、历史与偏好；恢复不重置偏好。你无法提交归属、审核人、当前版本指针、落地路径、包清单哈希或验证结果。
